texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的官员收到消息称我们与[pre_ftl_country.GetName]共享科技数据。他们告知我们这毫无疑问违反了开发利用法案，无论我们的本意如何。

[Root.GetName]在接下来的十年内将会被视为违反星系法。此外，我们还应缴纳巨额罚金。
texts.en:
Officials from the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have received word of our sharing of technological data with the [pre_ftl_country.GetName]. They have informed us that this is a clear violation of the Exploitation Act, regardless of our intentions.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law for the next ten years. In addition, we have been issued with a hefty fine.
